new_defects.title: Diagnostics fold status line goes stale: stays 'paused' after a Resume from the task manager, even after the fold finishes, and is blank when Diagnostics opens on a paused fold
new_defects.repro:
Throwaway, airplane mode.
1. Settings → Advanced → Diagnostics → «Fold keyword forms» → OK.
2. Open /tasks and press Pause on the fold row. The Diagnostics line reads «… · paused».
3. Press Resume in the task manager, and watch the Diagnostics line until the fold is done.
4. Separately: shut down during a fold, restart and unlock, then open Diagnostics.
new_defects.expected: The line follows the job: «Keywords checked: N of 2 254 … » while it runs, then the final «Keywords folded: 331 · mentions moved: 7 041 …» line. On opening Diagnostics with a paused fold, it shows the paused state.
new_defects.actual: After the task-manager Resume, the API goes running 985 → 1059 → … → done 2536. The line keeps reading «Mots-clés vérifiés : 650 sur 2 254 (28.8 %) · Mentions déplacées : 3 410 · suspendu» indefinitely, which misstates a completed fold as suspended. After a restart with a paused fold, the line is empty ("") when Diagnostics opens.
new_defects.evidence: w_m.json diag_line_samples_after_tm_resume and diag_line_after_done (fr, data4); w_i.json line_before_shutdown (API running 990, line «… · paused»); w_j.json and w_l.json diag_line_on_open = ""; shots/M11-diag-line-stale-fr.png, M11-diag-line-after-tm-resume-en.png.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/app-diagnostics.js:207-221. `_pollFoldJob` exits as soon as `s.state !== "running"`, and it is only ever started from `foldKeywords` (:222-243). Nothing restarts it when the job is resumed elsewhere (the task manager), and nothing reads /status when the Diagnostics section opens. Fix direction: poll while state is running OR paused, or start a poll when the section opens, or listen for the job's state change.

new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/app.css:1287 sets `.tb-label { flex:0 0 34%; max-width:34%; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }`. src/static/app-corpus.js:1505 renders kwLabelHtml (term plus tag) inside that one ellipsised anchor, so the tag, which comes after the term, is always the first thing cut. Let the label wrap, or keep the tag outside the truncated span (truncate only .kw-term), or put it on its own line as the Rising-windows rows do.

recheck.summary:
Independent re-check of row M on build 0deff9c4. I used my own fresh encrypted seed (scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py STATE C with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026, OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset and OO_EXTRACT_LEMMA=0 at seed time only), not a copy of the walker's folders. data1 is the seed, and data2, data3 and data4 are copies of its pristine state. Every boot had neither variable set, and /api/system/lock-state read "locked" and then "unlocked-encrypted" after the real #pw/#btn-unlock form. Servers: port 8962 for data1, and 9062 (8962+100) for data2, data3 and data4 in turn. All were stopped by PID after checking /proc environ. All four .db files still have no SQLite header. Airplane mode held throughout: /api/system/network read online:false after every one of the 28 consent popups I opened, each closed with "Stay offline". Zero off-host requests, page errors, console errors or HTTP >= 400 in any run. The worktree is still clean (git status --porcelain is empty).

Result: all 14 items are CONFIRMED on the fixed build.
- M1 is still present for "nouvelles": trend total 0, with the display term passed to a resolver that lemmatises only one step.
- M3, M4 and M8 still fail for the reasons given.
- M7 and M14 are still present.
- The nine new defects all reproduce: the stale Diagnostics fold line, clipped Top-list tags, the boot race, untranslated Explore text, the English chip hover, the English Bulletin "Ouvrir", word-cloud overlap, and the consent lanes stuck at "…". The consent stall reproduced during a running fold: 4.2 s with "Go online" active, because /api/custody/settings took 5 720 ms.

I also report two new findings on the same surfaces:
- The Explore mind map lets the i18n DOM walker translate a keyword as if it were interface text ("errors" becomes "erreurs", "أخطاء" or "错误", with no tag).
- The mind-map level toggle clips "Keywords" to "Keywo" at 1440 px in en.

items.evidence:
Fresh fold on my own seed:
- /api/insights/trend?term=nouvelles → total 0, resolved {term:'nouvelles', normalized:'nouvelles'} (the emptied row).
- term=nouvelle → total 109, resolved {term:'nouvelles', normalized:'nouveau'}.
- term=nouveau → 109 (r_a.json trend_*).
- /api/insights/top?group=true lists the chip row as {term:'nouvelles', normalized:'nouveau', mentions:109}.

simplemma, per the app's lemmatize(): fr nouvelles → nouvelle, and nouvelle → nouveau. So the fold chained two steps, and the resolver tries one.

Fixed as the walker says: registros → normalized registro, 83; районах → район, 55; избирателей → избиратель, 56.

items.root_cause: src/analytics/queries.py:171-177. _resolve_by_lemma builds one lemmatize() step per language ({nouvelle}). That «nouvelle» row is itself a husk the fold emptied, so _prefer_surviving (queries.py:207-210) finds no alternative with mentions and returns the 0-mention exact row. Contributing: src/static/app-insights.js:142 passes the display term f.term («nouvelles»), although the row already carries the live key normalized='nouveau'.
items.suggested_fix: In _resolve_by_lemma (or only in _prefer_surviving), follow the lemma chain to a fixed point: repeat lemmatize() on each candidate for up to about 3 hops, collect every candidate, and keep only rows with mentions, still refusing when several distinct rows survive. Independently, have the landscape and other keyword surfaces resolve by the stored key: pass f.normalized, or add a key= parameter to /api/insights/trend. Otherwise any display surface that outlives its key hits the husk.

Stale after a task-manager Resume:
- Fold → OK, then /tasks row «running Folding keyword forms into their base form Pause 5 / 2 254 keywords · 0%» → Pause. The API reads paused at 6/2254 and the Diagnostics line reads «Keywords checked: 6 of 2 254 (0.3%) · paused».
- Resume in /tasks: the API goes running 174 → 550 → 850 → 1064 → 2190 → done 2536 within 9.2 s.

items.root_cause: src/static/app-diagnostics.js:207-220. _pollFoldJob is the only writer of #kw-fold-status, and it exits as soon as state !== 'running'. It is started only from foldKeywords (app-diagnostics.js:222-244, wired at src/static/app-boot.js:754-758). So a resume from anywhere else, or a page that opens Diagnostics on an existing paused or running job, never reads /api/insights/keyword-fold-job/status.
items.suggested_fix: When the Diagnostics section opens (and at boot if it is open), read the status once and paint _foldStatusText. Keep polling while state is 'running' or 'paused', at a slower interval when paused, so a resume from /tasks or a restart is picked up and the final «Keywords folded: …» line replaces «paused». Alternatively, drive the line from the jobs poll the task manager already uses. The search re-index line (_pollSearchReindex, app-diagnostics.js:283-296) has the same shape and likely the same defect.

- 1440x950: label box 893–1079 px (186 px, overflow hidden, nowrap, ellipsis). 20 of 20 rows tagged; 12 full, 8 partial («рекордную явку» tag 1027–1089, «явку избирателей» 1040–1103, «подсчет голосов», «задержках из-за», «голосов прошел», «из-за необычно», «большого числа», «избирательные»).

- No horizontal page scroll at either width. The fact is reachable only by hovering: the #oo-tip ends «— Not translated — shown in its own language. — Language: Russian» (r_d.json hover_*).
items.root_cause: src/static/app.css:1287 (.tb-label { flex:0 0 34%; max-width:34%; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap }) together with src/static/app-corpus.js:1505-1506, which renders kwLabelHtml(t) (term + tag) INSIDE the clipped <a class="tb-label">, so the ellipsis eats the tag first.
items.suggested_fix: Keep the tag out of the ellipsis. Render the tag as a sibling after .tb-label (flex:0 0 auto), or make .tb-label a flex row where .kw-term gets min-width:0 plus overflow:hidden plus ellipsis and .kw-tag gets flex:0 0 auto. That way the term truncates and the tag always shows. On phones (the existing max-width:600px block) let the label take its own line.

items.ref: new:Boot race: after a reload, Corpus landscape and Home 'Trending now' keep English frames when the locale loads after their fetch, and are never repainted
items.evidence:
Deterministic with /static/locales/fr.json delayed 2.5 s (Playwright route), fr UI, on build 0deff9c4. I did not see it on 4 undelayed reloads; the walker's natural occurrence is in its w_c.json.
- Landscape, 9 s after reload with html lang=fr: «regional in anglais, allemand, portugais et espagnol», «избирательные in russe», «logiciel translated from anglais et espagnol Q7397». Tag hovers read «Not translated — shown in its own language. — Mentions by language: anglais 60 · allemand 55 …» and «Verified translation (cross-language concept). — Original: software …» (r_b.json delayed_landscape; shots/BR-landscape-delayed-fr.png).
- Home: «Trending now: 投票率 in chinois 2 mentions, against 2 in the prior period — too thin a baseline to divide by …», next to a translated «Plus dans Analyses →» (r_b.json home_ov_trending).
- The same screenshot shows the race is wider: the briefing cards also stay English («Single-source: “Technology coverage (edition 12) — zh”», «Resurfaced after 337 days: …», «updated 27 septembre 2026», «Details & corpus») (shots/BR-home-delayed-fr.png). On an ordinary fr reload those read «Source unique : …» / «Réapparu après 337 jours : …».
- Nothing repaints them. Control reload without the delay: correct French.
items.root_cause: src/static/i18n.js:137-145. init() awaits load(c) and resolves OOI18N.ready but never dispatches oo:langchange, so the repaint list in ooKwRepaintOnLangChange (src/static/app-corpus.js:1113-1180) never runs for the boot locale. The keyword surfaces paint once with t()/tf() inside [data-i18n-dyn] nodes the walker must skip, and none awaits OOI18N.ready: loadLandscape (src/static/app-insights.js:119-147), _renderOverviewTrends (src/static/app-home.js:1415-1437) and loadBriefing/cardTitle. OOI18N.ready is used only by a handful of surfaces (app-home.js:105-110, 494-500; app-settings.js:249; app-analysis.js:2133).
items.suggested_fix: In init(), after the non-English load and apply(), call ooKwRepaintOnLangChange() once (it re-runs only populated hosts, so it is cheap). Or dispatch a boot-time oo:langchange that the existing listener handles. Alternatively, have loadLandscape, loadHomeTrends/_renderOverviewTrends and loadBriefing `await OOI18N.ready` before painting. Add a test that delays the locale file.

items.ref: new:Explore surface untranslated in fr, ar and zh: mind-map hint, server method/caveat, VADER framing caveat and chart unit
items.evidence:
fr, ar and zh, Explore избирателей and software (r_c.json):
- Hint (fr): «Glisser pour déplacer … Taille de police = volume d'articles partagés. Branches grow outward from the centre; each leaf hangs off its strongest relative. PMI/co-occurrence association, two hops (relatives, and their relatives) Association is not causation; PMI on small samples is noisy.»
- Cloud view: «… Cloud view: weight-ordered, no links. …».
- ar and zh: the same English tail after translated first sentences.
- Framing note in all three: «These are measurable framing SIGNALS (tone via VADER sentiment; emphasised terms via frequency), not a judgement that any outlet is biased. VADER is an ENGLISH lexicon…», while its table headers are translated (MÉDIA / TONALITÉ (VADER); الوسيلة الإعلامية; 媒体).

- Shots: EX-mindmap-fr.png, EX-mindmap-ar.png, EX-mindmap-zh.png.

This is a caveat (the VADER English-only disclosure) that does not ship ×12, against the informed-consent rule.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-corpus.js:630. The hint's second sentence is a literal English ternary, concatenated with esc(g.method) and esc(g.caveat) into ONE text node the walker cannot match. The server strings live at src/analytics/queries.py:3813-3819 and src/api/insights.py:355-356, with no keys. src/awareness/framing.py:32-40 (_CAVEAT) is rendered raw at src/static/app-ai-tools.js:2111 (esc(d.caveat)). The chart unit is hard-coded at src/static/app-corpus.js:713 (unit: "mentions"), and the legend composes «n=… · mentions» as one string.
items.suggested_fix: Wrap the two view sentences in t() as separate keyed strings. Have the graph and framing endpoints send method/caveat as keyed frames (the pattern M14 used for the keyword-stats caveat) and render them with tf(). Pass t("mentions") as the unit. Add all new keys ×12.

items.ref: new:Explore word cloud labels overlap into an unreadable pile
items.evidence:
fr, 1440x950, Explore избирателей → Nuage de mots. The bounding-box scan of #mm-svg text finds 23 overlapping pairs among 13 labels: «избирателей» over «очередь» (37×25 px), «из-за» over «прошел» (69×16 px), «прошел» over «проголосовать» (33×26 px), «прошел» over «рекордную явку» (101×22 px), and more.
- software: 22 overlapping pairs among 18 labels (20 in zh).
- The screenshot shows «очередь» drawn over «большого», «рекордную явку» over «проголосовать/подсчет» (shots/EX-cloud-fr.png; r_c.json cloud_overlap).
- The mind-map view's hop-2 leaves pile up the same way («code/manage/privacy/staff», shots/EX-mindmap-fr-software.png).
items.root_cause: src/static/app-corpus.js:515-522. The cloud places node i at r = 16·√i on a golden-angle spiral (x scaled ×1.6) with no measurement of text extent and no collision check, so 9–18 px words 60–130 px wide overlap. In the map view, leaves are spread over span·0.8 of their arm at a fixed R2 (app-corpus.js:545-551) with no spacing by label width.
items.suggested_fix: Place each label using its measured width (getComputedTextLength or a canvas measure), stepping along the spiral until its box clears the already-placed boxes (a standard word-cloud placement). Give the map leaves a minimum angular gap derived from label height/R2, or fall back to more rings.

items.ref: new:Consent popup lane list can still read '…' seconds after opening while 'Go online' is already enabled (intermittent)
items.evidence:
en, Settings → Advanced → Keywords → Keyword translations, Concepts to load = 5 → «Load from Wikidata». The lanes box and #net-consent-ok were polled every 25 ms from the click.
- Idle, data1: 12 opens. The dialog appears after 109–172 ms showing «…» with Go online enabled (disabled=false), and the lanes fill after 255–346 ms (r_h.json idle).
- During a running fold on data3: the FIRST of 10 opens still read «…» 4.2 s after opening, with the interfaces already filled, Go online enabled and «Working…» in the top bar (r_h2.json busy[0] filled_ms null; shots/CONSENT-slow-busy0.png). The other 9 filled in 227–432 ms.
- Cause measured on data4 at fold start: /api/custody/settings took 5 720 ms, against about 200 ms idle; scheduler/config 167 ms, safety/settings 77 ms (r_i.json lat[0]).
- Every popup was closed with «Stay offline», and /api/system/network stayed online:false.

Severity P2 rather than P3: the missing block is the one disclosing «Runs on every collection pass: Press collection n=9033 …», that is, that consenting starts collection. It is absent while consent is clickable.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-core.js:1406-1411. _netConsentConfig awaits Promise.all of three reads, so the lanes render only after the slowest (/api/custody/settings), with no timeout. src/static/app-core.js:1425-1444 shows the dialog with lanesBox «…» and never disables #net-consent-ok until the lanes have rendered.
items.suggested_fix: Disable «Go online» until _renderNetLanes has run (or has failed and rendered an honest «could not read which lanes are on» line). Render each lane as its own read arrives instead of waiting on Promise.all. Put a short timeout on the three reads so a slow custody read cannot hold the disclosure hostage. Consider why GET /api/custody/settings costs about 200 ms idle and 5.7 s under a fold.

items.ref: new:Explore mind map translates keywords that match interface strings (errors → erreurs / أخطاء / 错误) with no tag
items.evidence:
/api/insights/graph?level=keyword&term=software returns the node {id:'errors', label:'errors'}. In the Explore mind map and cloud it renders as «erreurs» (fr), «أخطاء» (ar) and «错误» (zh), with no «traduit de» tag and no hover, among bare Spanish neighbours (código, ayudar, herramienta). In en it reads «errors» (r_c.json fr/ar/zh.explore_sw.mm_labels; shots/EX-mindmap-fr-software.png vs MM-levels-en-1440.png). fr.json:2838 and zh.json:2838 key "errors" as interface text.

The corpus keyword is English «errors» (the fold merged it with es «errores», known M11). The reader is shown a French or Arabic or Chinese word the corpus never contained, presented as data. This is the case the S04-06 data-i18n-dyn guard (src/static/app-boot.js:43-48 comment) exists to prevent.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-corpus.js:644. The node label is emitted as `<text …>${esc(n.label)}</text>` with no data-i18n-dyn attribute, so the i18n DOM walker (src/static/i18n.js:83-90 apply → doText) translates any keyword that equals a locale key.
items.suggested_fix: Add data-i18n-dyn to the mind-map/cloud <text> nodes, and to any other SVG or keyword surface still missing it; the Analysis-window mind map, observatory labels and bulletin review should be audited too. Then label them through kwLabelParts as in M8. A regression test can seed a keyword equal to a chrome key («errors») and assert it is not rewritten in fr.
